source.author: mrwilliewillieofberlin
source.text:
Running a restaurant in your 30s hits different. One minute you’re chasing invoices, the next you’re plating a dish you’re proud of. Some days are packed, some days test your patience, but every day you show up again.

Building something in Berlin isn’t just about food, it’s about resilience, community, and believing your dream belongs at the table.

Make it a date with us this weekend at the @Village House 
#mwob #entrepreneurship #berlinrestaurant #fyp #nigerianrestaurant
